svg.text: Freely Three-Loop Capability Lifecycle — 五层架构
feedback → wt-create → B1→B2→dev → test-pre-merge → pr-create-guarded → pr-review-guarded → CI → pr-merge-guarded → wt-close
task-mode: auto / wait / listen — driven by scan + A2A/continuity evidence
Manager Agent (逻辑角色 — ACP session, develop worktree)
patrol → task-source-scan → 读取 scan.json (CHAIN_ACTIONS/next_action) → judge
Worker Agent (逻辑角色 — ACP session, feature worktree)
入口: Task.message → prompt file → worker-agent.md (intent_kind → skill mapping)
Worker Agent (逻辑角色 — ACP session, feature/hotfix worktree)
dev-loop-execution, fix-execution, feat-execution, branch-management, worktree-*, constitution-guard
入口: Task.message → prompt file → worker-agent.md (intent_kind: edit→dev-loop, merge→branch-mgmt, ...)
Protocol Layer (实线框 = 进程/守护进程, 通过 Unix socket 通信；DB 文件单独标注)
JSON-RPC over Unix socket — default adapter: acp；Runtime 与 AI CLI Tool 之间的会话代理
session/new → session/resume → session/prompt → stopReason → session/ping → session/close
三级缓存: L1 resume (0 token) | L2 fork (增量, 同 system prompt) | L3 fresh (全量, 新 prompt)
select_launch_kind: fresh | resume | fork | prompt — ensure_runtime_tool_session_anchor
prompt 组装: build_prompt → start-lead-agent.sh → Agent 角色 + 治理 + 上下文源 + 执行规则
空闲超时: 900s — 崩溃恢复: _ensure_server_alive + _restart_server
REST + SSE over Unix socket — Agent 间通信 (Manager ↔ Worker), 零文件交接
Task 状态机: submitted → working → completed | failed | input-required
Manager 委派: a2a-exit --state submitted --agent-id worker --skill ... --message "完整 prompt"
Runtime 发现: tasks/list --state submitted → Task.message → prompt file → 启动 Worker
SSE 通知: TaskStatusUpdateEvent → Manager 下一轮 patrol 感知 Worker 完成
exit_kind 映射: stop_ai→failed, delegate_workers→submitted, resume_manager→completed, worker_done→completed
a2a-exit → a2a_tasks → delegate_workers → tasks/list → Task.message → Worker ACP session
AI CLI Tool Layer (实线框 = 外部独立进程, 与 Runtime 通过 ACP JSON-RPC 通信)
Claude ACP family / codex-acp / opencode acp
adapter: acp (current default) — tool registry → monitor-ai-acp.sh → run-acp-prompt.py
cc / kiro-cli / iflow aliases enter Claude ACP family by registry
ACP fork: SESSION_PARENT_ID → 独立 session, 不污染父 session JSONL
实线框 = 真实进程 (有 PID, 可启停)
虚线框 = 逻辑角色 (AI Agent, prompt 注入定义)
点线框 = Skill 集合 (Manager / Worker / shared)
━━ 实线箭头 = 同步调用 — — 虚线箭头 = 异步通知/回环 ··· 点线箭头 = scan 读取
